verdict.rationale: vercel-gh-1 confirms the Vercel platform lets developers 'choose a template' during project import as an alternative to Git-connect deployment, matching the one-click template/starter story, and vercel-docs-14 shows broad framework support (40+ frameworks) that templates would target. However, the evidence pack lacks any detail on the scope/breadth of the template gallery, categories of starters, or the actual one-click 'Deploy' button flow that Vercel is known for. missing for 10: documentation of the templates marketplace/gallery, breadth/categories of available starters, and details of the one-click Deploy button mechanism.
